declared_limitations: Open-frame rack has no continuous top. Top corners are post cap centers; the top polygon contains crate tops and empty space. It is a virtual image layer, not actual plywood or a physical roof.
Side braces and shelf goods are at multiple depths. End polygon preserves their painted fixed-view appearance but not correct per-part surface depth or lighting normals.
Alpha holes must remain transparent with invalid depth. Rendering an opaque top/end quad would introduce a regression.
Post cap diamonds and feet extend 3-6 native pixels outside centerline corner polygons. Quantify omitted texels; do not fix by source UV clamp or arbitrary expansion of each face.
